content.text: {"core": "Change ends what has finished so the next form can start. In Faith, it works on the held position — the thing kept in place through not-knowing, waited out rather than forced. Starved, the ending never lands: what has already died stays propped up inside the waiting, and the holding curdles into keeping a corpse warm. Nothing new gets its turn.", "sheetLine": "The waiting has outlasted its reason; something finished is still being held in place."}
